scientific_question: Does actual historical lineage/provenance carry causal credit for later credit-allocation and decision behavior after present numeric state, recent input, information privilege and lineage-bookkeeping resource budgets are matched, and does any effect survive an ordinary explicit-state reduction?

claim_boundary.allowed: A narrow causal-lineage bookkeeping claim under lineage-addressed delayed-credit interventions in a matched synthetic/native-structural testbed.
disallowed: reuse of H7 exploratory settings or observations
reuse or rescue of any consumed H5, NI01, PD01 or C19 identity

candidate.name: NativeActualLineageCredit
candidate.mechanism: Use append-only StructuralController logical identities, parent tuples and tombstones to resolve actual ancestry for delayed credit allocation; shared present numeric state and recent input remain unchanged.
candidate.lineage_privilege: Exact parent relation carried by the candidate's own historical structural events; no truth labels, world labels, future query labels or evaluator-only targets.

comparators.name: ExplicitParentTable
comparators.mechanism: Independently reconstruct the same parent relation from the same admitted structural event stream using an ordinary explicit parent table and answer the same ancestry/credit queries.
comparators.information_privilege: Exactly the same structural events, present state and recent input as the candidate.

comparators.name: RecentWindowState
comparators.mechanism: Use matched present observables and a fixed recent-event window only; no older ancestry relation.
comparators.information_privilege: Same present observables and recent event window; no evaluator target.

comparators.name: ProvenanceDestroyedControl
comparators.mechanism: Preserve live slots, current tensors, masks, recent input, event counts, parent arities and resource shape while replacing parent assignment with a deterministic opaque-ID permutation fixed before scoring.
comparators.information_privilege: Same cardinality and resource surface as candidate, but actual ancestry is destroyed.

observable_envelope.candidate_only_semantic_state: actual parent/tombstone relation, also supplied losslessly to ExplicitParentTable through the same admitted historical event stream
forbidden_bypass: different current tensors or active masks across matched twins
different recent input window across matched twins

held_out_construction.history_family: balanced branching/merge event histories that end in matched live-state twins with opaque logical IDs
held_out_construction.present_state_matching: byte-identical synthetic present feature vector and identical recent input window within each ancestry twin; native formal adapter must additionally hash-match all declared present tensors/masks/counters before intervention
held_out_construction.ancestry_difference: at least one queried live node has different actual ancestor membership across the twin while parent arity histogram and live-slot cardinality are equal
held_out_construction.query_timing: query/intervention sampled only after the matched present-state checkpoint is fixed

interventions.lineage_required: Deliver delayed signed credit to the descendants of an opaque queried historical ancestor after the matched present-state checkpoint; downstream decision uses only the resulting credited live set plus the already-matched present state.
interventions.provenance_destroyed: Apply the identical delayed-credit procedure after deterministic parent reassignment while keeping current observables and bookkeeping shape fixed.
interventions.explicit_reduction: Apply the identical delayed-credit procedure using ExplicitParentTable reconstructed independently from the same event stream.
interventions.redundant_control: A separate control exposes the queried descendant set in the recent input window; lineage destruction should then add no material benefit or impairment, preventing a generic cue-use effect from being mislabeled lineage causality.

resource_contract.scope: lineage bookkeeping and query path only; shared SparkBrain substrate excluded symmetrically

training_calibration_tuning.threshold_tuning: none after this contract is frozen
training_calibration_tuning.dev_use: implementation invariants and construction validity only; DEV effect sizes must not alter formal seeds, margins, comparator definitions, resource caps or interventions

statistics.redundancy_metric: absolute candidate-vs-provenance-destroyed accuracy difference in redundant_control
statistics.interval: two-sided percentile 95% using linear Type-7 quantiles

quality_guards: all present-state match hashes equal within ancestry twins
candidate and ExplicitParentTable resolve identical actual descendant sets on construction oracle checks
opaque IDs carry no ancestry information by lexical tests
raw intervention rows exist before any aggregate scoring
decision_rule.PASS: all quality guards pass AND primary-effect CI95 lower >= 0.05 AND necessity-effect CI95 lower >= 0.10
decision_rule.FAIL: quality guards pass AND (primary-effect CI95 upper <= 0.01 OR abs(candidate_accuracy - explicit_parent_accuracy) <= 0.01)
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: quality guards pass and neither PASS nor FAIL condition is met

integrity_order: fresh Analyst GO and fresh unconsumed identity before formal execution
exact-head CI and dedicated pre-START green
formal matched-state checkpoint hashes before intervention
raw intervention observations before target-derived scoring

formal_boundary.identity_plan: lp01-actual-lineage-causal-credit-official-v1 only after fresh Evidence Analyst acceptance; not reserved by this contract
